behavior: Against a fixture line containing an astral-plane character (a UTF-16 surrogate pair, two code units per codepoint) before a known symbol, java_hover, java_definition and java_references each report line/column matching the file's true offset in 1-based coordinates; none counts the astral character as one code unit or as one codepoint instead of its true two-code-unit width.
rationale: Distinct from TCON-TOOL-0001: a conversion can handle single-unit non-ASCII correctly yet still mishandle surrogate pairs, since LSP counts UTF-16 code units and an astral codepoint is two of them -- the exact fixture this feature's context and INV-TOOL-1's observable seam name [INV-TOOL-1]. Falsifies iterating by Unicode codepoint (e.g. `for...of`) instead of raw UTF-16 code units (`.length`) -- the classic off-by-one this fixture exposes.
